dcterms:description: A dataset comprising 400 image pairs divided into three groups: FG3DCar with 195 image pairs of vehicles, JODS with 81 image pairs of airplanes, horses, and cars, and PASCAL with 124 image pairs of bicycles, motorbikes, buses, cars, and trains. The dataset includes ground truth cosegmentation masks and flow maps.
dcterms:title: New Dataset for Cosegmentation and Dense Correspondence
